noRecords: No matching market records available for these filters.
geoDenied: Location permission was denied. You can still enter your location manually.

geoUnsupported: Geolocation is unavailable in this browser. Enter your location manually.
geoUnavailable: Your location could not be obtained. Manual location entry remains available.
geoSuccess: Coordinates received: {latitude}, {longitude}. Your village has not been identified by reverse geocoding.
demoLocation: Fictional demo markets have no coordinates and are not linked to your real location.
manualOptions: Enter manually. Verified provider options are not available yet.

transportNotice: These transport assumptions are editable estimates.

loadQuoteNotice: The round-trip-load quote is multiplied by the calculated loads/trips.
roadUnavailable: Road distance unavailable; routing cannot be calculated.
sameReturn: Assume empty return distance equals outbound distance for every trip

reasonGrade: The reported grade does not match the selected grade.
reasonInvalid: Invalid market record or reported prices.
reasonDate: The observation date is invalid or in the future.
reasonDataset: Synthetic and reported records cannot be ranked together.
